## Objective

Deliver a new starter edition and selected Curator adoption using existing setup receipts.

## Scope

- New project specialization
- Read-only assessment
- Earlier-edition and recovery compatibility

## Entry conditions

- Complete neutral Template distribution is current.

## Exit criteria

- Two distinct disposable profiles and prior-edition adoption cases preserve identity/content/preferences and report actual static/runtime state.

## Risks

- No real-project registration, root adoption or rollout is part of this phase.
